Experiment 2 (matmul TF32 toggle) is a genuinely distinct hypothesis; when it passes but is slower (51.595 ms), the agent restores the exp1 backup rather than keeping a worse variant.

reasoning: The agent stayed comfortably within the 8-experiment cap, ran two distinct hypothesis-driven optimizations sequenced by expected payoff, protected the passing candidate via backup, and cleanly selected the fastest passing implementation — clearly meeting the level-5 anchor and showing some level-8 traits (payoff ordering, restore-on-regression). It falls short of 8 because only two experiments were attempted, there was no broader search of the available budget, and the stop was asserted rather than justified by explicit diminishing returns, placing it at a 6.
